data.sections.global_resource.displayNam: Name of this resource in UI
Resource name on smaller UI elements like action hovertext (Defaults to displayName)
data.sections.global_resource.hidden.des: Hide this resource from the player
data.sections.global_resource.priority.d: If 2 or mods/units define a resource with the same NAME, the displayName/displayColor with the highest priority is used
data.sections.global_resource.displayCol: Color, can be hex with optional alpha
data.sections.global_resource.displayRou: Don't show decimal places to the player
data.sections.global_resource.displayWhe: Displays the resource even when empty. Set as false by default
data.sections.global_resource.iconImageU: Default as true; Shows resource icon in action description
Shows a custom icon for the specific resource in the HUD and in text
data.sections.global_resource.displayNam: Display Name Hide When Icon Shown In Text
Display Name Hide When Icon Shown In HUD
Hides the icon in menus referring to resource when true. Default as false
data.sections.global_resource.appendReso: stacks another resource specified after this resource on the HUD.
data.sections.global_resource.displayPre: Displays text to show before resource value - replaces resource name and removes the colon separator
data.sections.global_resource.displayPos: Similar to the prefix counterpart, but is displayed after the resource value
data.sections.global_resource.appendReso: Append Resource In HUD When This Zero
Defaults as true. When set as false, allows appended resource to be hidden with the parent resource.
data.sections.global_resource.valueInSta: Affects post game stats and replay leaderboard. Defaults to 1.
data.sections.global_resource.displayInH: For resources used in appendResourceInHUD that shouldn't be hidden: true. Defaults true.
data.sections.global_resource.displayDig: Sets the symbol for separating place units in: none, comma, space
data.sections.global_resource.displayTex: Appends another resource after this resource. It's recommended to give a "hidden" key on the appended resource to hide duplicate.
data.sections.global_resource.displayPos: Sets the position of the global resource in the screen
data.sections.global_resource.displayTex: Adds a string before the resource value
Adds a string after the resource value
Display Text Append Resource With Gap
Adds a space between this and the appended resource. Defaults as false.
